description: Price: $0.02 USDC per call on Base, paid automatically via x402 from X402_PRIVATE_KEY. Latest SEC Form 13F-HR holdings for one fund manager, by CIK or name (e.g. berkshire, pershing square, bridgewater): top positions with ticker, CUSIP, shares, value and % of portfolio, portfolio totals, and quarter-over-quarter changes (new, added, trimmed, exited) vs the prior 13F, with period, filing date and EDGAR links. As filed, up to 45 days after quarter end; not current positions. Failed calls (4xx/5xx) are not charged. Informational only, not investment advice.
